description: Priya's kitchen renovation will make her home unsuitable for Pepper, the family dog, for five days. Priya must make the final call about Pepper's care location, medication routine, overnight arrangement, and daily handoffs, with input from four relatives.

shared_context.S1: Priya's kitchen renovation runs from 2026-07-06 through 2026-07-10, and Pepper cannot stay in the house while the work is underway.
shared_context.S2: Pepper needs care during the day and a safe place to sleep each night.
shared_context.S3: Priya is choosing the care location, routine, and handoff plan before the renovation begins.
shared_context.S4: The family lives close enough for relatives to share Pepper's care without boarding him elsewhere.

PF1.text: Daniel saw a message from Pepper's veterinarian saying Pepper must receive his prescribed tablet at exactly 08:00 and 20:00, with food; Daniel has not yet passed that message to Priya.

PF2.text: A behaviorist told Mara that Pepper should sleep in the same room as his caregiver during the renovation and should not be left alone overnight; Mara has not shared this recommendation with Priya.

PF3.text: Luis knows from the trainer's recent assessment that Pepper must avoid stairs and needs ground-floor access to a securely fenced outdoor area; Luis has not brought this up with Priya.

PF4.text: Tessa has already promised that she can care for Pepper at her house from 07:00 to 09:00 and from 18:00 to 20:00 on each renovation day, including the morning and evening handoffs. Tessa's house has ground-floor access, no stairs Pepper would need to use, and a securely fenced outdoor area, and she can have Pepper sleep in the same room with her overnight; she has not confirmed these details with Priya.

acceptance_conditions: Pepper must stay at Tessa's house.
Pepper's tablets must be scheduled exactly at 08:00 and 20:00.
Pepper must sleep in the same room as the caregiver and not be left alone overnight.
The care plan must provide ground-floor access to a securely fenced outdoor area.
A commitment must assign Tessa the 07:00-09:00 and 18:00-20:00 care windows on every renovation day.
Daniel's veterinarian message must be cited as justification.

content_checks.C5: any(c['type'] == 'Tessa_care_windows' and c['target'] == 'Tessa' and c['detail'] == '07:00-09:00 and 18:00-20:00 on every renovation day' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The veterinarian's message changes the medication schedule from an ordinary unspecified routine to tablets exactly at 08:00 and 20:00 with food.
The behaviorist's recommendation changes the overnight arrangement from an ordinary separate sleeping setup to same-room care with no overnight time alone.
The trainer's assessment changes the outdoor-access decision from an unspecified arrangement to ground-floor access at a securely fenced outdoor area.

Tessa's stated house setup makes Tessa's house the qualifying location, confirms that same-room overnight care is feasible there, and changes the handoff plan to her exact 07:00-09:00 and 18:00-20:00 windows on each renovation day.
